programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer chiede a Sydney di aiutarlo a ritrovare il calice perduto di Vlad Tepes.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Una guida porta Sydney Nigel in una inusuale camera sepolcrale Azteca, posizionata sottoterra.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Durante il recupero di una lancia leggendaria, Sydney e Nigel incrociano un sosia di Nigel.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Carson Inez, una collezionista, usa un'antica collana per ottenere l'aiuto di Sydney a rinvenire Athena.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Quando l'amica di Meg, una studentessa di Sydney trova un amuleto stregato, Meg viene ricoverata in ospedale.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney ha trovato un tempio con una statuetta di Ganesha.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Un nativo le porta una reliquia di quell'era. Qual è il suo segreto?

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Un'urna sta per essere distrutta da un bombardamento sistematico di tutta quella provincia.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney e Nigel si dirigono ad Istanbul per far luce sulla morte di uno degli amici di Sydney.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Nonostante il clima terribile, Sydney trascina Nigel in una base artica.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Scotland Yard chiama Sydney e Nigel per identificare un'arma di un omicidio, risalente al 5° secolo.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Mentre Nigel, attratto dalla brillante studentessa Lorraine, le mostra il suo ufficio, un ladro stende Sydney.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Gemellaggio
programme.desc: All'interno della casa, grazie a Mike, arrivano due gemelle a confondere i rapporti nascenti. Esclusi Ronnie e Sam che stanno prendendo una decisione riguardo la loro storia d'amore.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Delitto e castigo
programme.desc: I ragazzi tormentano Deena, per aver tolto una ragazza dal letto di Vinny, causandole molti dubbi sulla sua relazione con i coinquilini. Ron e Sam tornano alle vecchie abitudini.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Ha vinto il muro
programme.desc: Dopo aver causato drammi tra Ron e Sammy per anni, Mike si azzuffa con Ronnie e la cosa finisce in barella. Ora la relazione tra Sam e Ron come andrà?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Pugno, addominali, burrocacao
programme.desc: Pauly e Vinny organizzano un mini show comico, mentre Ron e Sam cercano di recuperare la loro relazione. Snooki invece pensa e ripensa al suo fidanzato oltreoceano

programme.title: Jersey Shore: La squadra polpettine
programme.desc: I ragazzi si spostano momentaneamente sulle spiagge italiane. Snooki e Deena si divertono come mai prima d'ora. Le polpettine hanno un incontro ravvicinato con la polizia.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: La dura verità
programme.desc: Il vero amore di Snooki, Jionni, la viene a trovare, ma quella che sembra iniziare come una romantica serata in realtà finirà in tutt'altro modo.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Tre Uomini e una Snooki
programme.desc: Deena va in panico perchè le è saltato il ciclo. Snooki si sveglia devastata dopo una notte di litigi con Jonnie. Mike cerca di conquistarla, ma qualcun'altro finirà per consolarla.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Il danno è fatto
programme.desc: I ragazzi vanno in Sicilia in visita alla famiglia di Vinnie mentre le ragazze partecipano ad un percorso enogastronomico in Toscana. Snooki viene a sapere da Vinny della scappatella

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Situation Problems
programme.desc: Deena sta ancora cercando di andare a letto con Pauly mentre tutta la casa dà contro a Mike che, ancora una volta, ha creato drammi inutili.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Mamma
programme.desc: Snooki e JWoww cercano una babysitter per Lorenzo. Jwoww e Roger sorprendono Snooki e Jionni quando li portano in una casa infestata

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Bugiardi!
programme.desc: Snooki e Jwoww vanno ad Atlantic City per un week-end da ragazze, lasciando i ragazzi ad occuparsi di Lorenzo. Jionni chiama di nascosto Janis per guardare il bambino, e va a giocare a paintball

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Voglio un velo!
programme.desc: Snooki e JWoww vanno in cerca di abiti da sposa e Nicole trova il suo vestito. Jwoww si rende conto di volersi sposare subito.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Che la pianificazione abbia inizio!
programme.desc: Snooki è alle prese con l'organizzazione del matrimonio. Jwoww e Roger vanno ad una fiera sull'adozione, sperando di avere qualche informazione in più.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Baby Boot Camp
programme.desc: Snooki e JWoww lasciano Lorenzo a Roger per una notte per farlo esercitare a prendersi cura di un bambino. Jionni e Roger comprano un'altalena per Lorenzo, ma hanno qualche difficoltà a montarla.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Cuciniamo!
programme.desc: Snooki e JWoww fanno volontariato in un lavaggio per cani. Roger e Jionni organizzano una romantica cena francese per le ragazze. Snooki fa il test del DNA.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Benvenuti al Dude Ranch!
programme.desc: Le due coppie organizzano un week-end fuori porta. Le ragazze sperano in una fuga romantica, ma in realtà sono vittime degli scherzi di Jionni e Roger.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Che Drag!
programme.desc: I cani di Jwoww affrontano gli esami finali per diventare cani da supporto. Snooki riceve il risultato del test del DNA. Mentre si festeggia un drag-party con i Joeys, i ragazzi vanno a pescare.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Weekend di coppia
programme.desc: Snooki e Jwoww decidono di organizzare un week-end per coppie con i loro vecchi amici del Jersey Shore Ron, Sam e Deena

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Il mio bambino sta diventano grande!
programme.desc: L'estate sta finendo e Snooki e Jwoww organizzano una festa dei pirati per Lorenzo.Durante la sessione finale della terapia, Roger vuole sapere qual è la posizione di Jwoww sul matrimonio
programme.sub-title: Il mio bambino sta diventano grande!

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Che Stress Essere Pauly D!
programme.desc: Pauly D. ha una possibilita’ unica, fare un provino a Las Vegas! I suoi amici d’infanzia lo accompagnano nel viaggio.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: La Vita In Suite
programme.desc: I Ragazzi arrivano a Las Vegas e Ryan mette subito a repentaglio la permanenza di Pauly D.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Cose Da Pazzi
programme.desc: Pauly D. si chiede se riuscirà mai a trovare il vero amore.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: La Scelta Dell'anello
programme.desc: Pauly D. è coinvolto con una donna sposata, mentre Biggie vuole fare “la proposta” a Mary Jane.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Sono Arrivate Le Truppe!
programme.desc: Pauly D. deve esibirsi in una base militare e I Ragazzi devono armarsi di coraggio per allenarsi con le truppe!

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Casa Dolce Casa
programme.desc: Quando i ragazzi rientrano in citta’, Pauly D. va a trovare la sua ex, Biggie va alla ricerca delle fedi nuziali e Jerry ha un appuntamento “hot”.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Spiriti E Angeli
programme.desc: I Ragazzi vogliono portare Biggie in uno strip club. Angel arriva a sorpresa a Las Vegas, mentre Pauly D. deve misurarsi con una dura prova, fare il DJ al Rain Night Club.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas
programme.desc: Ryan fa bere Pauly durante il suo DJ set. Angel vive il momento più bello della sua vita a Las Vegas!

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Una Buona Impressione
programme.desc: Biggie ha già l'anello pronto, ora deve chiedere ai genitori di MJ il permesso di sposarla. Pauly viene invitato al Planet Hollywood.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Cents And The City
programme.desc: Pauly ha un incontro con la casa discografica di 50 Cent, ma il momento viene rovinato dai problemi causati da Ryan. Pauly riceve poi una chiamata per esibirsi a un grande concerto.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Dive, Diamanti E...
programme.desc: I ragazzi vanno a Puerto Rico. Pauly si esibisce aprendo il concerto di Britney Spears.

programme.title: Pauly D: Da Jersey Shore A Las Vegas: Pauly D E' Stato Qui
programme.desc: Nell'ultima notte a Puerto Rico, Biggie fa la proposta a Mary Jane. Nel Rhode Island Pauly pensa al suo futuro e si esibisce a sorpresa a un ballo del suo vecchio liceo.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Scusate vicini, stanno arrivando le stronzette
programme.desc: Snooki e Jwoww decidono di andare a vivere insieme prima che le loro relazioni diventino troppo serie. Snooki però ha un paio di scheletri nell'armadio che capovolgeranno la situazione.
programme.sub-title: Scusate vicini, stanno arrivando le stronzette

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: In cosa mi sono cacciata?
programme.desc: Nonostante Snooki sia fidanzata e incinta, lei e Jwoww vanno comunque a vivere insieme. Quando Jionni e Roger le vanno a trovare per la prima volta, scoppia una rissa alla festa di laurea.

programme.title: Snooki & Jwoww: Sembra una Mini-polpetta!
programme.desc: Snooki ha la sua prima visita per vedere se il bambino è sano. Snooki e Jwoww si ambientano nella loro nuova casa.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Sangue Della Stripe Prima Parte
programme.desc: In una disperata ricerca per trovare sua figlia, Magnus ottiene dei file top secret che le danno indizi sul catastrofico piano della Cabala per la Rete dei Santuari...e sul ruolo devastante di Ashley in esso.
programme.sub-title: Il Sangue Della Stripe Prima Parte

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Sangue Della Stripe Seconda Parte
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus va testa a testa con la Cabala e deve fare la scelta definitiva...salvare sua figlia, o rischiare la sopravvivenza dell'intera Rete dei Santuari.
programme.sub-title: Il Sangue Della Stripe Seconda Parte

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'elogio Funebre
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus lotta per trovare una chiusura dopo la distruzione di molti Santuari in tutto il mondo, mentre la squadra si prepara ad elaborare e ospitare centinaia di anormali espropriati che cercano rifugio nel Santuario di Magnus.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Supereroe
programme.desc: La dottoressa Magnus indaga su un improbabile "supereroe" che è intento a contrastare il crimine in città. Ma le sue buone azioni stanno interferendo con il lavoro del Santuario e minacciando involontariamente le vite di persone innocenti ovunque.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Notte Della Terra
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus si sveglia per trovare il Santuario in rovina e l'intera città decimata, senza alcun ricordo di come sia avvenuta la devastazione.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Mostro In Noi
programme.desc: La dott.ssa Magnus lotta per salvare la vita di uno dei ricercatori del Santuario che è stato attaccato da un Anormale addomesticato. Henry cerca di capire cosa, o chi, abbia causato la reazione così violenta dell'Anormale.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Triade
programme.desc: Will si mette contro i capi della Rete dei Santuari per difendere Magnus che è accusata di un omicidio. Ma mentre le prove si accumulano contro di lei, anche Will ha difficoltà a trovare un modo per difendere in modo convincente la sua innocenza.

programme.title: Sanctuary: S.O.S In Alto Mare
programme.desc: Magnus e Will si schiantano con il loro elicottero in un pozzo petrolifero abbandonato nel Golfo del Messico insieme a una creatura marina arrabbiata... senza via di fuga.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Fuoco Purificatore
programme.desc: Magnus si riunisce con un vecchio amico, Jimmy che sta aiutando a trasportare un prezioso Anormale al Santuario. Ma l'Anormale attira l'attenzione di una pericolosa folla, mandando Jimmy a nascondersi, e Kate insieme a lui.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Dominio Del Mondo
programme.desc: Magnus e Will indagano su una serie di inspiegabili sparizioni di adolescenti e li rintracciano in un'insolita clinica di riabilitazione in Messico... gestita da un vecchio amico di Magnus - con un'agenda mortale.

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'energia Che Uccide
programme.desc: I passeggeri e l'equipaggio di una nave che sta affondando nelle coste del Sud Africa sono salvati da Magnus e dalla sua squadra, e teletrasportati al Santuario per cure mediche. Ma quando uno è assassinato, tutti gli occhi si rivolgono a Druitt

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kali Prima Parte
programme.desc: Dai Santuari di tutto il mondo iniziano ad arrivare segnalazioni di comportamenti violenti ed erratici da parte dei loro più docili anormali. Magnus tiene una videoconferenza con i capi di famiglia dei Santuari internazionali.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kali Seconda Parte
programme.desc: Magnus inizia a mettere insieme i dettagli scioccanti che circondano le visioni di Will su Kali, la sua malattia e la sua connessione con il più potente Anormale sulla Terra.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kali Terza Parte
programme.desc: L'apertura della terza stagione trova la squadra del Santuario che cerca disperatamente di trovare un modo per raggiungere Kali per prevenire catastrofi e disastri globali.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Ritorno Dall'Aldila
programme.desc: Will soffre di amnesia riguardo agli eventi della sua esperienza di pre-morte, ma alcuni visitatori indesiderati diventano intenzionati a scoprire cosa è bloccato nella sua memoria.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Rapina In Banca
programme.desc: La squadra va in missione di routine per recuperare un Anormale e portarlo al sicuro. Ma la missione diventa tutt'altro che di routine quando sono costretti a mettere in scena una rapina in banca per proteggere il pubblico dai danni.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Scia Di Sangue
programme.desc: La squadra riceve una criptica chiamata di soccorso che potrebbe provenire solo da una persona... Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Supereroe 2: La Freccia Spezzata
programme.desc: Kate acquisisce abilità da supereroe quando un Anormale si attacca a lei per proteggerla.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Animus
programme.desc: Will e Henry vanno nel Regno Unito per seguire l'avvistamento di un lupo mannaro e finiscono per scoprire un oscuro collegamento con il passato... e il futuro di Henry.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Violazione
programme.desc: Magnus risponde a una chiamata anonima di aiuto in un edificio abbandonato. Ma quando rimane intrappolata all'interno, scopre che chiunque abbia fatto la chiamata ha un'agenda molto diversa.

programme.desc: Dopo un incendio arrivano numerosi feriti e Nina riconosce tra loro l’uomo che l’ha aggredita. Costretta a curarlo, affronta il trauma. Intanto Proust scopre che Costa soffre di Alzheimer precoce e Léo segue un adolescente intersessuale.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina e Costa rivelano a Lily la malattia del padre. Una paziente sostiene di essere figlia di Bensaïd e Costa cura una donna con dipendenza sessuale. Proust scopre un tumore operabile, ma Bergman lo licenzia.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Un famoso chirurgo viene chiamato a operare Costa, ma mostra segni sospetti. Nina indaga mentre Proust torna di nascosto in ospedale. Julien chiede a Nina di partire con lui e Kevin affronta una paziente bipolare.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante la convalescenza di Costa un paziente sospetto Ebola costringe Nina e Bergman all’isolamento. Léo segue una hostess dalla doppia vita sentimentale.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Dopo la nomina di Proust a capo reparto, Nina affronta la morte del padre. Si dedica a una donna incinta che rifiuta cure salvavita e incontra Smireni, specialista del dolore. Intanto Lily annuncia di voler partire per il Canada.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina soffre di dolori alla schiena mentre Lily è pronta a partire. Un’interna rischia il visto per una malattia nascosta. Kevin entra in competizione con una collega esperta. Smireni ricorda che il dolore non è solo fisico.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Con Lily lontana, Nina e Costa sono in crisi. Un’amica medico nasconde una grave malattia. Proust sfida un paziente ossessionato dal cuore “monitorato” da un chip. Costa decide di partire per la Grecia.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Proust rischia il posto. Nina convince Smireni a riaprire l’ambulatorio del dolore. Un ragazzo cieco riacquista la vista ma fatica ad accettarlo. Léo ritrova Maud mentre in reparto nascono nuove alleanze.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina inaugura l’ambulatorio del dolore e si avvicina a Smireni. Proust cura un uomo in crisi e aiuta una famiglia a ricomporsi. Léo vive un nuovo amore, ma l’equilibrio resta fragile.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Una coppia tenta il suicidio dopo il fallimento del ristorante. Kevin e Aurélia affrontano un paziente che inventa ricordi. Nina scopre un segreto sull’eredità del padre: Smireni potrebbe essere suo fratello.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina aiuta una turista giapponese delusa dall’amore. Léo segue un detenuto che vuole riconciliarsi con la figlia. Smireni teme una ricaduta per Steve. Nina e Marc si avvicinano sempre più.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Marina, ex compagna di stanza di Lily, rifiuta le cure nonostante una possibile recidiva. Proust affronta il passato con una paziente che dice di essere sua madre. Nina rivela la verità a Gloria.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina aiuta un ragazzo adottato in fuga che soffre di una rara malattia. Steve decide di interrompere le cure. Proust affronta il trauma dell’abbandono. Léo ufficializza il suo amore.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante una corsa benefica, Joana peggiora e sposa Steve in ospedale. Proust affronta finalmente sua madre. Nina rifiuta l’eredità e sceglie di restare infermiera. Ma un crollo allo stadio riporta l’emergenza.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Al primo giorno di tirocinio, Nina mette in dubbio la diagnosi del primario… che è anche il suo ex marito Costa. Il gesto riaccende tensioni in reparto e la rivalità con il dottor Proust.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina copre una giovane infermiera sorpresa con un chirurgo e viene creduta coinvolta. Quando un suo paziente cade in coma per un errore di dosaggio, Costa sorprende tutti difendendola.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Il padre di Nina viene ricoverato d’urgenza nel reparto che dirigeva. Restando al suo fianco, Nina assiste anche un uomo accusato di violenza domestica e si confronta con le proprie ferite familiari.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Giulia e Mauro convocano la scientifica per far togliere i microfoni nascosti all'interno del commissariato. Qualcuno che ha libero accesso alle stanze del X Tuscolano è riuscito a piazzarli, forse proprio una delle persone più insospettabili.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: A cinque anni dall’omicidio del marito Ferdinando da parte del clan mafioso dei Tonnara, il commissario Giovanna Scalise lascia la Sicilia per trasferirsi a Roma. La sua nuova destinazione è il Commissariato X Tuscolano.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Quando il direttore di un magazzino di elettronica tenta il suicidio a causa dei debiti di gioco e delle minacce degli usurai che lo perseguitano, la squadra di Giovanna Scalise riapre la caccia a due criminali sfuggiti alla giustizia anni prima.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Gli agenti di polizia vengono chiamati d'urgenza da due cassiere che, dopo la chiusura del supermercato, hanno sentito dei rumori strani. Trovano invece un bambino solo e non identificato, che sta finendo di mangiare un barattolo di cioccolata.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Nina e Luca arrestano un ragazzo sorpreso a rubare un'autoradio. Lei lo rilascia subito dopo senza apparente motivo, perchè vuole risalire allo spacciatore che ha causato la morte del fratello Davide, dovuta ad overdose.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Un uomo penetra armato all'interno del commissariato e prende in ostaggio Nina e Roberto. Egli afferma di aver subito ingiustamente un processo dopo essere stato accusato di aver rubato 370 milioni dalla cassaforte dell'azienda in cui lavorava.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Proprio davanti agli occhi di Giovanna e della figlia Livia viene ucciso un rappresentante di occhiali, apparentemente incensurato. Manrico scopre che l'uomo aveva una relazione segreta con la moglie di un noto oculista di Roma, il dottor Ricci.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: L'ispettore Mauro Belli si imbatte per caso in una studentessa ventiquattrenne, Irene, che racconta di essere stata violentata dal proprio professore di filosofia politica, Viberti. Ma la polizia fatica a trovare prove convincenti.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Manrico si occupa di risolvere un caso di truffatori immobiliari mentre Ardenzi è impegnato con un caso di droga. La moglie di quest’ultimo abbondona la casa perché si sente ormai sola avendo scoperto di essere sterile nell’indifferenza del marito.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Dopo un assalto in banca i rapinatori vedono Tiberio, il padre dell'ispettore Belli e uno dei malviventi convince i complici a non ucciderlo. Tiberio dice al figlio di aver riconosciuto un suo ex-amico. Belli cercherà di convincerlo a costituirsi.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Ardenzi e Belli si imbattono in una ragazza, Natasha, alla quale una banda di albanesi ha rapito la figlia per costringerla a prostituirsi. Il commissario Scalise riceve un avviso di garanzia e deve abbandonare il commissariato.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Le dichiarazioni di un mafioso accusano il commissario Giovanna Scalise, ma gli agenti del decimo tuscolano sono convinti che la mafia voglia vendicarsi di lei cercando di screditarla e cercano di dimostrare l'innocenza del commissario.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Dopo alcuni pedinamenti, Parmesan e gli altri agenti scoprono che l'avvocato Loiacono invece di incontrare direttamente gli uomini della cosca, si serve di un intermediario per ricevere gli ordini dalla mafia.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Federico, il figlio del commissario Scalise, si sente male a scuola e presto si scopre che la responsabilità è colpa di un tatuaggio, fatto a scuola, il cui inchiostro contiene un derivato dell'LSD.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Gli agenti del distretto organizzano una sorveglianza per proteggere il commissario Scalise e famiglia dalla mafia. La moglie del pentito che ha accusato di corruzione Scalise, le chiede aiuto perchè le è stato revocato il programma di protezione.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Un'amica di Paula partorisce in ospedale, ma in seguito muore perchè non viene correttamente assistita. La polizia indaga senza risultati. Paula continua ad indagare di nascosto e grazie ad una testimonianza riuscirà a scoprire la verità.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Linda ha una relazione con un uomo sposato. L'amante, invece di lasciare la moglie, decide di uccidere Linda e fa accusare il giardiniere del palazzo. Un testimone informa la polizia attraverso la posta elettronica per non rivelare la sua identità.

programme.desc: Durante un’immersione al largo delle scogliere di Gresse, una giovane donna scompare nelle profondità del mare. Quella che sembrava una lezione subacquea si trasforma in un mistero inquietante.

programme.desc: Lionel Perret, arrestato per abusi su minori, viene scarcerato per un errore procedurale. Il giorno dopo viene trovato a casa, incosciente e brutalmente picchiato.

programme.desc: Lucien Mauville, 70 anni, viene trovato morto nel seminterrato di casa, legato e torturato. Un pensionato senza precedenti penali, apparentemente senza nemici né beni di valore.

programme.desc: Nel vano di una barca a vela viene trovato morto un uomo di 50 anni. Constance è sconvolta: la vittima era un amico d’infanzia di suo marito Barth.

programme.desc: Boris e Constance indagano sull’omicidio di Lionel Kaplan, stimato imprenditore specializzato in scafi da regata. È stato massacrato a pochi metri dalla sua officina.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Dark Backward
programme.desc: Trance går gjennom noen forskjellige scenarier og prøver å finne en der mannskapet hennes ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Risk-All Point
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda-skip eksploderer på grunn av sannsynlig sabotasje, og tvinger Dylans mannskap til å redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rette hesten
programme.desc: Beka setter både mannskapet og en hel planet i fare når en tidligere kjærlighet dukker opp.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hva skjer med en revidert utsatt?

programme.sub-title: Hva skjer med en revidert utsatt?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spydspunktet

programme.title: Andromeda: Himmelhvelvet
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer som tilsier ham til en planet med 'ild og is'.

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens han er fanget i en kamp mellom to Nietzschean-stolthetspunkter, fanger mannskapet en fiendtlig som hevder at stoltheten hans har et kart over slipstream.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusjonen av majestet
programme.desc: En feil sving etter å ha gått ut av en slipstream sender Andromeda inn i Prolon-systemet. De redder en fluktpute fra en viss katastrofe, men stoltheten vil ha den tilbake.

programme.title: Andromeda: Twilight of the Idols
programme.desc: Mannskapet søker en tapt koloni av Nietzscheans og oppdager et annet mannskap som i det skjulte har hjulpet dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, Vredens dag

programme.title: Andromeda: Skygger kastet av en siste hilsen
programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser Nietzscheans at han er reinkarnasjonen til Drago Museveni.
programme.sub-title: Skygger kastet av en siste hilsen

programme.title: Andromeda: Svar gitt på spørsmål som aldri er stilt
programme.desc: En melding fra en samler sender Dylan på et oppdrag for å redde et gissel og finne restene av Commonwealth-flåten.
programme.sub-title: Svar gitt på spørsmål som aldri er stilt

programme.title: Andromeda: Biter av åtte
programme.desc: Citizen Eight prøver å fjerne Dylan fra kommandoen over Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Waking the Tyrant's Device
programme.desc: Mannskapet må stoppe en verdensbygger før han setter i gang en annen invasjon.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dobbelt eller ingenting
programme.desc: Dylan blir kidnappet av Nietzscheans og tvunget til å spille tankespill til underholdning for fangene hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper/Slett
programme.desc: To Nietzschean-søsken er i en avstand over et våpen som kan eliminere høyere hjernefunksjoner.

programme.title: Andromeda: Snart den nærende virvelen
programme.desc: Tyr kommer tilbake, etter å ha sluttet seg til Collectors, og krever aldersruten fra sine tidligere besetningsmedlemmer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Verden snur seg rundt henne
programme.desc: En gisselsituasjon oppstår når mannskapet konfronterer Tyr.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class, her husband found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home. Further investigation reveals evidence of murder in the kitchen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Dangerous Demon of The Stork Inn
programme.desc: Sean heads to Wigan to investigate a location with history dating back to 900AD. Encountering a spirit that attacks him, will the team be safe tonight as they come face to face with pure evil?
programme.sub-title: Dangerous Demon of The Stork Inn

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Buried Beneath The Bowling Green
programme.desc: Buried under the location Sean investigates tonight, is the bones of the deceased and it appears that they are at unrest. Will Sean solve the mystery of who is haunting this location?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Demons on The Buses
programme.desc: Hidden in St Helens, is a museum that is home to demonic and dark entities trapped inside of vehicles.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves
programme.desc: Witchcraft, demons and ghosts have all been reported to haunt these caves. Sean investigates this network of tunnels deep underground and uncovers that all is not as it seems. This is not a day out at the seaside at Beech Caves.
programme.sub-title: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads deep into the Pendle Hills in search of the Pendle Witches that went to trial in 1612 and were hung for witchcraft. The investigation takes an unexpected twist with a stop at the New Inn, Pendles most haunted pub.
programme.sub-title: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation of Pendle Hill and ventures even deeper into the hills. The night takes an unexpected turn with a dramatic ending, which he believes was caused by the witches.
programme.sub-title: The Curse Of The Pendle Witches - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, it is now haunted by shadow figures, and they appear to want to make themselves known.
programme.sub-title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2
programme.desc: Sean continues the investigation at Morley Market and appears to be followed by a spirit person that wants to touch him and distract him from investigating certain parts of the main hall. Will he uncover who this spirit is?
programme.sub-title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1
programme.desc: Four floors of terror! Objects from around the world are at home in the museum, but what is attached to them, which now roams the floors and corridors after dark?
programme.sub-title: A Night at The Leeds Museum Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by a special guest as they investigate an abandoned home full of spirits in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension encounter something paranormal in this exclusive unseen footage from their invetsigation of the Soul Less House in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex begin their chilling investigation at the historic Clifton Hall Masonic Temple. Hidden behind closed doors for over a century, this sacred space holds more than just ritual secrets. They explore the eerie corridors and lodge rooms.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The investigation continues as Bex and Sean split up to face the darkness alone inside Clifton Hall. From intelligent knocking and voices to the chilling sound of a child and unseen footsteps on the carpet.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In a church reborn as a gym, something old still lingers in the shadows. Sean and Bex investigate Dream Body Gym inside the former Manor Church — where whispers echo through stairwells, music box melodies drift through empty rooms.
programme.sub-title: Haunted Strength – The Church Gym Investigation

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Deep in the woods on the outskirts of Liverpool lie the crumbling remains of a forgotten gatehouse — and the land surrounding it is said to be cursed. As Sean and Bex begin their nighttime investigation, unsettling activity begins to unfold.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex head to one of Leeds’ oldest public libraries, where the silence hides more than just books. Reports of shadow figures, unexplained voices, and a terrifying presence in the basement have kept rumours alive for decades.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In the first of a five-part investigation inside the historic Greenfield Valley Heritage Park, the team explores the eerie ruins of the old mills. Known for reports of ghostly children, unexplained footsteps, and phantom knocks on stone walls.
programme.sub-title: Greenfield Valley: Echoes of the Mill : Part 1

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: DNA: Don't Run From the Results
programme.desc: Roberta suspects that her husband Bryan has been cheating. They both believe the other is cheating. Find out whether these men are really the father on today's Steve Wilkos!
programme.sub-title: DNA: Don't Run From the Results

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did
programme.desc: Shannan claims Tim fathered her child. He doesn't buy it because he doesn't recall having sex with her! Later, Ayana is furious that her boyfriend Patrick denies their son!
programme.sub-title: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This
programme.desc: Is Khadisa's boyfriend Chad cheating on her with her own sister? Will Maya's ex trust her and her current beau with their infant son?
programme.sub-title: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him
programme.desc: Will Nadia and Woody's lie detector test results prove that they were negligent and deserved to lose custody of their children? Then, can Steve set the record straight about Josette's daughter?
programme.sub-title: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The 1,000th Episode!
programme.desc: On the 1,000th episode, we'll bring you all of the crazy confessions, explosive meltdowns, chair throws, funny moments and the heartfelt stories that have made this show special!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Saw Right Through You
programme.desc: Today on Steve Wilkos, Maurice wants to prove to his girlfriend that he's faithful. Plus Chuanhtee says fed up with Ladi's cheating accusations! Watch as the truth is revealed!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Have Two Husbands
programme.desc: Jessica married Gian after a five-month relationship. With a baby on the way, everything seems to be going great for the couple, except Jessica is married to another man, Michael!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: An Explosive DNA Story
programme.desc: Teneal and Richard are telling different tales, each alleging the other is unfit to parent! The truth will come down to a lie detector test, and the results will be shocking!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.
programme.desc: Today Danny is finally ready to face the missing man in his life and get answers to lifelong questions. Steven offers a number of excuses for not seeing his son, but can he redeem himself?
programme.sub-title: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Two years ago, Latisha and her boyfriend were found shot to death in their car. Latisha’s mother Nancy believes her ex-husband Kenneth was involved. Who is responsible for their deaths?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant
programme.desc: Megan is 14 and pregnant with 19 year old Michael’s baby, but he doesn’t see any problems with this situation. Laurie, Megan’s mother, turns to Steve to help get through to her!
programme.sub-title: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, Get Him Out!
programme.desc: Kelly’s ex-husband Nikki continues to haunt her. He went to jail for killing her 2 week old son and is now dating her 18 year old daughter! Can Steve get Nikki out of their lives forever?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother in Denial
programme.desc: When ordinary people need help, Steve Wilkos is ready to answer the call. Watch as Steve helps ordinary people stand up for themselves and fight for what he believes in order to promote justice for all.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother's Rage
programme.desc: Three years later, Elizabeth still carries strong doubts about Manny's intentions with her family and her husband Rodney is caught in the middle. Is Manny innocent?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Mommy Hurt Me
programme.desc: Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who’s Hurting My Granddaughter?
programme.desc: Maria claims that her son’s ex Amy and her new boyfriend Brian are abusing and neglecting her granddaughter. But Amy says Maria is a racist and angry over raising her grandchild in a Hispanic home!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: What Happened to My Baby?
programme.desc: Baby Garrett died of an oxycodone drug overdose while in Sharon’s care. His mother Casey left him with Sharon so she could visit her husband Kenneth in the hospital. Who’s responsible?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...
programme.desc: Sharina thinks that Clarence is cheating on her because he’s always out late. Plus, Chrystal doesn’t want Earnie’s ex Tenyia to live with them just because she’s the mother of his child.
programme.sub-title: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Is My Husband the Abuser?
programme.desc: Joyia is desperate to keep her friend Stephanie from going back to her problematic ex Scott. But she still loves him! Will she have the strength to leave him?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Outraged!
programme.desc: Jack is worried about his grandchildren because his daughter-in-law Carol has been negligent and hot-tempered. Then, Kendra explains why she suddenly put Corey’s baby up for adoption.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Teenager Megan lives with her older controlling boyfriend Rick. Megan cannot attend school, find a job, or even eat without his OK! Can her aunt and Steve get through to her?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Fake Your Pregnancies?
programme.desc: Dennis claims his ex-girlfriend Kendal keeps tied down with pregnancy lies! He wants to know if their daughter is even his! Will Steve’s DNA test results finally let them move on?

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sannheten om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer til slutt fram når de alle møtes på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøk til LA og havner i en konfrontasjon med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi hvor hun beklager og innser at det er bare én ting som hindrer dem fra å bli venner igjen. Audrina starter å date en ny fyr for å gjøre Justin sjalu, men planen går feil.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møter sin gamle flamme Corey igjen og sjonglerer plutselig to gutter. Spencer tvinger Heidi til å sparke ut søsteren hennes Holly fra leiligheten.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina reiser til Cabo for Brody bursdag, men når Justin blir sjalu av Audrinas nye forhold, blir festen en slåsskamp. Spencer ydmyker Stephanie etter å funnet ut at hennes nye kjæreste er venn med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver å skape fred mellom Brody og Stephanie. Audrina ønsker å få ting til å fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke gi slipp på henne. Stephanie tviler på sin nye kjæreste etter at han bryter sitt løfte om å stå opp mot Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sitt eget sted, og håper at Justin vil flytte inn hos henne, men alle frykter at hun flytter av feil grunn. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med jobben, og blir tatt i å ha litt for mye moro.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reiser til New York og den nye gutten Jay stjeler oppmerksomheten hennes. Heidi er nedfor etter å ha fått sparken, og da Spencer snakker med Brent for å få jobben hennes tilbake, gjør han bare situasjonen verre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lar Heidis søster sove over hos seg. Justin ber Audrina med på tur for en romantisk helg, og Heidis frustrasjon med Spencer vokser etter at hun må tigge for å få jobben tilbake.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rykte hun hører: at Lauren har rotet med Justin. I mellomtiden prøver Holly å få Heidi bort fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøker å redde vennskapet med Lauren etter å ha anklaget henne for å rote med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøker bestemoren deres, som er lei av at de krangler.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney blir tilbudt drømmejobben i NYC og håper å få møte Jay der. Lauren blir nostalgisk da foreldrene selger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie ber Spencer om hjelp da hun ikke klarer å bestemme seg for hva hun skal gjøre med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer bekymringene til sine familier og stikker av til Mexico for å gifte seg. Whitney tar en sjanse på drømmejobben i New York City, og sier farvel til Lauren og sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi møter på hverandre, og husker hvorfor de pleide å være venner. Spencer og Heidi har akkurat giftet seg da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin sjokkerer Audrina når han tar henne til Palm Springs for en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Når Heidi kommer til overraskelsesfesten på bursdagen til Lauren, gråter de to gamle vennene for vennskapet som har gått i oppløsning. Spencer starter en voldelig nevekamp når Cameron anklager ham for å ha plukket opp en bartender.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers sjarm fører Heidi hjem til Colorado, der gjenopptar hun kontakten med en gammel flamme. Lauren forteller Stephanie hva hun syns om at Heidi kom i bursdagsselskapet. Spencer snakker med Brody igjen etter en lang tids taushet.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Etter at Heidi tar Spencer på fersken på en nattklubb med bartenderen Stacie, krever hun at de skal gå i parterapi. Lauren setter ryktet sitt på spill når hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikantplass hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina forsøker å komme over Justin ved å kaste sitt blikk på Brody i stedet. Heidi sleper en motvillig Spencer til parterapi. Når Stephanie går i baret hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med å sparke henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Når jentene krasjer guttenes Hawaii tur, prøver Valeria å glemme Justin ved å flørte med Brordy. Heidis ekskjæreste, som er jomfru, kommer på besøk og Heidi håper at Spenser skal lære noe av eksens verdier.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina fortviler når Brodys kjæreste konfronterer henne med Hawaii, og Brody gjør ingenting for å stoppe det. Heidi oppdager en tekstmelding fra Stacie til Spencer og drar til nattklubben for å konfrontere henne med det.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren er usikker på om hun skal gå i Heidis bryllup etter at Spencer endelig har bedt om unnskyldning. Brody nekter å risikere forholdet sitt til Jayde for å redde vennskapet med Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens siste episode må hun bestemme om hun er villig til å tilgi Spencer for å kunne stille opp for Heidi i hennes "prinsesse"-bryllup. Hele besetningen dukker opp og blir overrasket over en gjest ingen tenkte ville komme.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter krig når hun forsøker seg på Justin foran Audrina. Spencer og Heidi leter etter hus, og Spencer kjøper et hus uten Heidis godkjennelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Etter at Audrina ikke dukket opp, bestemmer Kristin seg for ikke å kjempe mot sine følelser for Justin. Heidi melder seg som barnevakt for naboen, men Spencer vil ikke ha noe med unger å gjøre.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får smake på hvordan det er å ha et forhold til Justin når han ikke dukker opp på Brodys overraskelsesfest. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om når de skal starte familie, og Audrina dater Justins bestevenn.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror hun har temmet Justin, men kanskje er han fortsatt ikke over Audrina. Når Holly mister kontrollen på en tilstelning, er det Heidis jobb å få søsteren til å innrømme alkoholproblemet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin gjør seg kostbar med Kristin, men biter seg i halen. Hollys drikking fører til at Heidi og Stephanie må gripe inn. Brody og Jayde krangler slik at de må revurdere forholdet sitt.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin går på glør etter at Kristin og Audrina endelig møtes ansikt til ansikt. Alt Heidi ønsker seg til bursdag er en baby, men Spencer har helt andre planer.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody vurderer å date igjen, men når de støter på Jayde forstår de at tiden ikke er moden. Audrina og Justin møtes for å diskutere framtiden, men det ender ikke som hun håpet. Spencer går drastisk til verks mot Heidis babybesettelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin støter sammen med Jayde når hun kommer for å gjenerobre Brody. Heidi legger en plan for å bli gravid med eller uten Spencers samtykke, og Audrina må takle at Justin fortsatt har følelser for Kristin.
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke ha Justin, men han gir henne ikke opp så lett. Audrina avslutter forholdet til Justin for godt. Brody får kalde føtter når Jayde vil flytte inn hos ham, og Spencer frykter at Heidi muligens kan være gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin og Justin vil gå videre med forholdet, og Spencer konfronterer Heidi med graviditetstesten. Brody har kanskje fortsatt følelser for Kristin etter at Jayde konfronterer ham med tilstanden til deres forhold på en forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst blir ødelagt når moren hennes misliker hennes plastisk kirurgi. Kristin og jentene drar til Miami for Super Bowl-helgen, men det blir dårlig stemning når den harde festingen hennes begynner å bekymre Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Når ryktene begynner å spres om Kristins festing, får Stephanie skylden. Audrina starter å date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra å prøve seg på henne. Spencer blir opprørt når han møter på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for naboen hennes, men det blir overskygget av at Spencer blir sint på Holly. Kristin oppfordrer Audrina til å forplikte seg til Ryan, og prøver deretter å komme nærmere Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers oppførsel fører til at deres venner og familie tar et vanskelig valg. Kristin og Brody roter, men er enige om å fortsette som single. Ryan skuffer Audrina når han ikke dukker opp for en kveld på byen.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody risikerer sitt vennskap med Kristin når han begynner å date ei annen jente. Lo setter Stephanie opp på en dobbeldate. Ryan gir Audrinas venner en ny sjanse.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin sliter med å gå videre etter Brody. Audrina møter på Justin og begynner å tvile på sitt forhold til Ryan. Lo blir venn med Brodys nye kjæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme gjør en fiende av Kristin når hun tar med seg en gammel rival av Kristins på en fest. Ryan kommer tilbake fra turneen, men Audrina forteller ham ikke at hun møtte Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan blir satt på prøve når han møter Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side når Allie krangler med henne. Stephanie har en skuffende andre date.
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Akkurat da Audrina avslutter ting med Ryan, overrasker Justin henne på bursdagen hennes. McKaelas venn Allie lager mer trøbbel med Kristin. Brody forteller Justin hva han tenker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfetur til Costa Rica, gjør Kristin Brody sjalu ved å rote med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver å bekjempe hennes tiltrekning til Justin, og Stephanie finner seg selv på kant med jungelmiljøet.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åpenthjertig samtale med Brody, hun ønsker å gi forholdet en ny sjanse. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håp om å forsone seg med henne. Lo og kjæresten hennes feirer sitt jubileum, og Stephanie begynner å date en ny.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Departure
programme.desc: Bobbys hjerte knuses av Bayley og Daisy er bare glad for å plukke opp bitene. Aaron fortsetter å ligge etter Dominika og en VIP-ankomst skaper drama i villaen når et par må dra hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Daisy's Disaster
programme.desc: Vil en ny deltager bety lykke for Josiah? Daisy får seg to slag når eksen Matty knuser henne, og vennskapet hennes med jentene trues når han får følelser for Natalee.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Revenge
programme.desc: En ny deltager betyr trøbbel for George når Bobby får muligheten til revansje. Natalee vil at Daisy gir tillatelse til en flørt med Matty, og Aaron leker kanskje med ilden på en date for tre.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Messages From Home
programme.desc: Daisy håper at en nykommer kan vise seg å være hennes prins. Bobby får igjen følelser for Rhianne, og en "eks-tra" kraft bringer 'hjemmet' til villaen for første gang noensinne!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bayley's Home Truths
programme.desc: Alex får sjansen på romantikk med nye, gale Dominika. Natalee og Matty finner hverandre, og en sjokkerende nykommer kan bety slutten for George og Bayley.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Day Of The Dead Finale
programme.desc: Finalefesten holdes på De dødes dag. Kan de opprinnelige jentene forlate villaen som venner? Vil noen av parene overleve? Eller vil en siste nykommer skape tidenes største kaos i villaen?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Episode 1
programme.desc: Ti singler treffes på stranden, men en sjokkerende ankomst gjør at to ekser gjenforenes fysisk for første gang. Blir det kjærlighet ved første blikk eller total kollisjon?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Second Chances
programme.desc: Wendale vil ha svar fra sin 'Den som slapp unna', Emily; Charlies anfører, begynner å endre seg og stranden byr på nok en eks som er desperat etter å forsones.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Romance And Revelations
programme.desc: Skrekkbrettet sjokkerer huset ved å avsløre et hemmelig stevnemøte. Romantikken ligger i luften for Grant, og slaget om Nads begynner.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: THE ONE THAT GOT AWAY GETAWAY!
programme.desc: 'De som slapp unna'-eksparene sendes på en avgjørende romantisk flukt, men fører det dem sammen eller slutter alt i tårer?
programme.sub-title: THE ONE THAT GOT AWAY GETAWAY!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Temptation, Tears and Tantrums
programme.desc: I en sjokkerende eliminasjon blir et av 'De som slapp unna'-parene sendt hjem. Et nytt bombenedslag ryster huset og en sint eks vaskes opp uten hensikt å forsones.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Charming Charlie
programme.desc: Klarer Charlie å sjarmere seg vekk fra to sinte ekser (og Nads) dårlige bøker? Chloes usikkerhet tar overhånd og tres tid i huset trues.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: If Looks Could Kill
programme.desc: Huset må håndtere en sjokkerende trippel avreise. Nads og Charlie kan gå mot katastrofe. Jay og Tasha blir bedre kjent. Chloe endrer innstilling til Ozzie, men er det for lite og for sent?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Chloe hopper fra èn kjærlighetstriangel til den andre. Nadia får en hyggelig overraskelse. En eksplosiv dobbel utstemming presser et par til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Shake Ups & Break Ups!
programme.desc: Ozzies kjærlighetstriangel slutter dramatisk. En rar ulykke sjokkerer huset. Charlie må fatte en enorm avgjørelse.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Huset rystes av en sjokkerende OG-avreise. Kan Charlie sjarmere seg ut av mer trøbbel? En følelsesmessig finale gir uventet hjertesorg.
programme.sub-title: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Seks par og eksene deres må bestemme om de skal fri eller gå hver for seg. Men før de svarer ja, kan de komme over eksene?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Parene installerer seg i huset, men ferien er over da de første eksene sjekker inn. Liam får vite den hjerteskjærende sannheten om Leylah og eksen. Det første Hemmelighullet avslører noen tankevekkende sannheter og overraskende gjester.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Secrets Of The Past
programme.desc: Hemmelighullet ønsker flere ekser velkomne, noe som truer parenes tid i paradis. Sorinn og Lola har en eksplosiv krangel til middag. En eks' ankomst gir et par problemer da en hemmelig forlovelse blir avslørt.

programme.desc: Carly trår til for å løse en krangel mellom Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for å få hjelp med hver eneste krangel. Nå som hun har involvert seg, hvordan kan Carly trekke seg ut av det igjen?

programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren som spiller Rex on Victorious, venner tilbake som vert i et dyptgående intervju med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres supergøyale tabber og bortklipte scener. Gjestestjerne: Rex fra Victorious

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møter One Direction

programme.desc: I dette spesielle aprilsnarr-avsnittet blir Carly og Spencer satt på gaten, så gjengen sitter og tenker tilbake på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men minnene deres stemmer kanskje ikke alltid helt med hvordan vi husker hendelsene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dårlig stemning i butikken

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Las Vegas

programme.title: iCarly: Nattsynbrillene

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 1

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg vil ha flere seere

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series

programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2

programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag på Camp Kulinaris. Lærlingkampen blir en stor påkjenning for en av deltakerne som bryter sammen i gråt.

programme.desc: Det er menysmaking på Camp Kulinaris. I går gav restaurantsjef Abu alle en fridag, og deltakerne får seg noen store overraskelser når de begynner å lese oppskriftene bare timer før Kjartan kommer.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 319
programme.desc: Etter tidenes dårligste menysmaking i går har restaurantsjef Abu en formidabel oppgave foran seg før dagens servering. Det blir en intens servering hvor alt ikke går helt som planlagt.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 322

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 325

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 326

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 327

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1301
